# Outcomes

This engagement will empower PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC with greater visibility and actionable insights into pipeline performance and marketing return on investment, through the development of enhanced Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting. By automating data ingestion and integrating key platforms, PURE will gain accurate, timely, and granular information to support informed decision-making and drive business growth. Success will be measured by the quality and depth of insights, improved KPI tracking, and the scalability of reporting capabilities for future needs.

## Expected Business Outcomes

- **Granular Pipeline Insights:** Pure will benefit from detailed reporting of the journey from lead generation to Assets Under Management (AUM), allowing for more strategic pipeline management and resource allocation.

- **Accurate CAC Measurement:** Leadership will gain precise visibility into customer acquisition costs, with automated, integrated reporting that improves understanding of marketing ROI and enables cost optimization.

- **Automated Analytics Processes:** The automation of data ingestion and transformation pipelines will reduce manual effort, minimize errors, and ensure timely delivery of L2A and CAC analytics.

- **Integrated Reporting Suite:** Implementation of comprehensive Power BI dashboards and integrated data sources, including QuickBooks and Salesforce, will provide a single source of truth for pipeline and CAC metrics.

- **Improved KPI Tracking:** Enhanced definition, logic, and tracking of key metrics—such as Lead-to-AUM conversion rates and CAC KPIs—will support continuous performance improvement and informed business decisions.

- **Scalable Data Platform:** Establishing scalable data and reporting infrastructure on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse ensures future readiness for additional data sources and evolving business intelligence needs.

Success will be achieved when PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC has automated, integrated, and actionable L2A and CAC reporting embedded in daily operations, enabling leadership to optimize marketing investments and drive effective pipeline growth.
